EX-99.1 2 sndkq1-27ex991xpressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1Sandisk Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial ResultsNews Summary•Fiscal first quarter revenue was $11.0 billion, up 23% sequentially, with GAAP net income reported at $8.1 billion ($52.60 diluted net income per share, up 20% sequentially). First quarter Non-GAAP diluted net income per share was $49.51. •Returned $5.0 billion to stockholders through the repurchase of approximately 3.2 million shares during the quarter. Over the past two fiscal quarters, repurchased 6.0 million shares, representing approximately 4% of total shares outstanding. •Announced today an eight-for-one forward stock split, effective November 19, 2026, to make stock more accessible, including to employees through its employee stock purchase plan.•Expect second quarter 2027 revenue to be in the range of $12.2 billion to $12.6 billion, with expected Non-GAAP diluted net income per share on a pre-split basis in the range of $55.00 to $57.001.MILPITAS, Calif. — October 29, 2026 — Sandisk Corporation (Nasdaq: SNDK) today reported fiscal first quarter financial results.“We have started fiscal year 2027 with another quarter of strong performance, with robust and growing demand for our products driving outpaced growth in our data center business,” said David Goeckeler, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Sandisk. “We are executing on the strategy that we outlined at Investor Day, delivering growing and durable free cash flow through our technology leadership, deep customer partnerships, and disciplined financial management.” Sandisk also announced an eight-for-one forward stock split of its common stock to make the stock more accessible, including to employees. The stock split will be effected through an amendment to Sandisk’s Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation. Each of the Company’s stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 9, 2026 will receive seven additional shares for each share held, which will be issued after market close on Thursday, November 19, 2026. Trading is expected to begin on a post-split adjusted basis at the market open on Friday, November 20, 2026. Sandisk’s overall market capitalization and stockholder ownership percentages will not be affected by the stock split. Our estimated Non-GAAP tax expense may differ from our GAAP tax expense (i) due to differences in the tax treatment of items excluded from our Non-GAAP net income or loss; (ii) due to the fact that our GAAP income tax expense or benefit recorded in any interim period is based on an estimated forecasted GAAP tax expense for the full year, excluding loss jurisdictions; and (iii) because our GAAP taxes recorded in any interim period are dependent on the timing and determination of certain GAAP operating expenses. 3 Investor CommunicationsThe investment community conference call to discuss fiscal first quarter results and the Company’s business outlook for the fiscal second quarter of 2027 will be broadcast live online today at 1:30 p.m. Pacific/4:30 p.m. Eastern. The live and archived conference call/webcast and the earnings presentation can be accessed online at investor.sandisk.com.About SandiskBuilt on more than three decades of innovation, Sandisk is a vertically integrated global semiconductor company dedicated to delivering memory technologies that help people and businesses unlock the potential of their data. From the enterprise SSDs powering AI infrastructure to consumer devices and connected systems at the edge, Sandisk designs and manufactures memory solutions that fuel the modern digital economy.
